| Control | Where it appears | Classes `resetClass` drops |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `primaryButton` | Post, Reply and Save, the sign-in card’s Sign in, the report dialog’s submit, and a moderator’s main decision (Approve or Keep) | `comments__button`, `comments__button--primary` |
| `secondaryButton` | Cancel, Show comments, Load more comments and replies, Try again, Follow, the sign-in card’s Comment as a guest and Follow by email, Review in Comments, adding files to an Assets field, and a moderator’s other decisions | `comments__button`, `comments__button--secondary` |
| `quietButton` | The text actions on each comment (Like, upvote and downvote, Reply and the ··· toggle), the sort options and Show replies | `comments__button`, `comments__button--quiet` |
| `input` | Guest name and email, and text, email, number, URL and date custom fields | `comments__input` |
| `textarea` | The plain comment box, the report dialog’s details and multi-line custom fields. Rich mode’s editor follows the CSS custom properties instead | `comments__textarea` |
| `select` | Dropdown and multi-select custom fields | `comments__select` |
| `checkbox` | The reply-email opt-in, and checkbox and lightswitch custom fields | `comments__checkbox` |
| `radio` | The report reasons and radio custom fields | `comments__radio` |
| `link` | The link around each comment’s date, which is its permalink. Links inside a comment’s text are reached with `.comments__content a` instead | `comments__link` |
| `avatar` | Every avatar, on comments and beside the editor | `comments__avatar` |
